versos.hebraico: וְשַׁ֣בְתִּֽי אֲנִ֗י וָאֶרְאֶה֙ אֶת־כָּל־הָ֣עֲשֻׁקִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשִׂ֖ים תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וְהִנֵּ֣ה׀ דִּמְעַ֣ת הָעֲשֻׁקִ֗ים וְאֵ֤ין לָהֶם֙ מְנַחֵ֔ם וּמִיַּ֤ד עֹֽשְׁקֵיהֶם֙ כֹּ֔חַ וְאֵ֥ין לָהֶ֖ם מְנַחֵֽם׃

controles.web: Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.
controles.kjv: So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.
controles.livre: Depois me virei, e observei todas as opressões que são feitas abaixo do sol; e eis que vi as lágrimas dos oprimidos, que não tinham consolador; a força estava do lado dos seus opressores, porém eles não tinham quem os consolasse.

versos.hebraico: וְשַׁבֵּ֧חַ אֲנִ֛י אֶת־הַמֵּתִ֖ים שֶׁכְּבָ֣ר מֵ֑תוּ מִן־הַ֣חַיִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥מָּה חַיִּ֖ים עֲדֶֽנָה׃

controles.web: Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.
controles.kjv: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.
controles.livre: Por isso eu considerei os mortos, que já morreram, serem mais merecedores de elogios do que os vivos, que ainda vivem.

versos.hebraico: וְטוֹב֙ מִשְּׁנֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־עֲדֶ֖ן לֹ֣א הָיָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־רָאָה֙ אֶת־הַמַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה הָרָ֔ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשָׂ֖ה תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃

controles.web: Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
controles.kjv: Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
controles.livre: E melhor que estes ambos, é aquele que ainda não existe; que não viu as más obras, que são feitas abaixo do sol.

versos.hebraico: וְרָאִ֨יתִֽי אֲנִ֜י אֶת־כָּל־עָמָ֗ל וְאֵת֙ כָּל־כִּשְׁר֣וֹן הַֽמַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה כִּ֛י הִ֥יא קִנְאַת־אִ֖ישׁ מֵרֵעֵ֑הוּ גַּם־זֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל וּרְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ׃

controles.web: Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.
controles.kjv: Again, I considered all travail, and every right work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbour. This is also vanity and vexation of spirit.
controles.livre: Também vi eu que todo o trabalho, e toda a habilidade em obras, causa ao homem a inveja de seu próximo; também isto é fútil como perseguir o vento.

controles.web: The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself.
controles.kjv: The fool foldeth his hands together, and eateth his own flesh.
controles.livre: O tolo junta suas mãos, e come sua própria carne.

versos.hebraico: ט֕וֹב מְלֹ֥א כַ֖ף נָ֑חַת מִמְּלֹ֥א חָפְנַ֛יִם עָמָ֖ל וּרְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ׃

controles.web: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.
controles.kjv: Better is an handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.
controles.livre: É melhor uma mão cheia com descanso, do que ambas as mãos cheias com trabalho e perseguição ao vento.

versos.hebraico: וְשַׁ֧בְתִּי אֲנִ֛י וָאֶרְאֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃

controles.web: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.
controles.kjv: Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.
controles.livre: Então eu me voltei, e vi uma futilidade abaixo do sol:

versos.hebraico: יֵ֣שׁ אֶחָד֩ וְאֵ֨ין שֵׁנִ֜י גַּ֣ם בֵּ֧ן וָאָ֣ח אֵֽין־ל֗וֹ וְאֵ֥ין קֵץ֙ לְכָל־עֲמָל֔וֹ גַּם־עיניו לֹא־תִשְׂבַּ֣ע עֹ֑שֶׁר וּלְמִ֣י׀ אֲנִ֣י עָמֵ֗ל וּמְחַסֵּ֤ר אֶת־נַפְשִׁי֙ מִטּוֹבָ֔ה גַּם־זֶ֥ה הֶ֛בֶל וְעִנְיַ֥ן רָ֖ע הֽוּא׃

controles.web: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then, do I labor, and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.
controles.kjv: There is one alone, and there is not a second; yea, he hath neither child nor brother: yet is there no end of all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with riches; neither saith he, For whom do I labour, and bereave my soul of good? This is also vanity, yea, it is a sore travail.
controles.livre: Havia um que era sozinho, sem filho, nem irmão; e seu trabalho não tem fim, nem seus olhos se fartam de riquezas; nem diz : Para quem estou trabalhando, e privando minha alma do que é bom? Também isso é futilidade e enfadonha ocupação.

versos.hebraico: טוֹבִ֥ים הַשְּׁנַ֖יִם מִן־הָאֶחָ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵשׁ־לָהֶ֛ם שָׂכָ֥ר ט֖וֹב בַּעֲמָלָֽם׃

controles.web: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
controles.kjv: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
controles.livre: Dois são melhores do que um, porque eles têm melhor recompensa por seu trabalho.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י אִם־יִפֹּ֔לוּ הָאֶחָ֖ד יָקִ֣ים אֶת־חֲבֵר֑וֹ וְאִ֣יל֗וֹ הָֽאֶחָד֙ שֶׁיִּפּ֔וֹל וְאֵ֥ין שֵׁנִ֖י לַהֲקִימֽוֹ׃

controles.web: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.
controles.kjv: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.
controles.livre: Porque se vierem a cair, um levanta ao seu companheiro; mas ai daquele que está só, pois caso caia, não há outro que o levante.

versos.hebraico: גַּ֛ם אִם־יִשְׁכְּב֥וּ שְׁנַ֖יִם וְחַ֣ם לָהֶ֑ם וּלְאֶחָ֖ד אֵ֥יךְ יֵחָֽם׃

controles.web: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?
controles.kjv: Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm alone?
controles.livre: Também se dois deitarem juntos, eles se aquecem; mas o sozinho, como se aquecerá?

versos.hebraico: וְאִֽם־יִתְקְפוֹ֙ הָאֶחָ֔ד הַשְּׁנַ֖יִם יַעַמְד֣וּ נֶגְדּ֑וֹ וְהַחוּט֙ הַֽמְשֻׁלָּ֔שׁ לֹ֥א בִמְהֵרָ֖ה יִנָּתֵֽק׃

controles.web: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
controles.kjv: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
controles.livre: E se alguém prevalecer contra um, os dois resistirão contra ele; porque o cordão de três dobras não se quebra tão depressa.

versos.hebraico: ט֛וֹב יֶ֥לֶד מִסְכֵּ֖ן וְחָכָ֑ם מִמֶּ֤לֶךְ זָקֵן֙ וּכְסִ֔יל אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־יָדַ֥ע לְהִזָּהֵ֖ר עֽוֹד׃

controles.web: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.
controles.kjv: Better is a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king, who will no more be admonished.
controles.livre: Melhor é o garoto pobre e sábio, do que o rei velho e tolo, que não aceita mais receber advertência.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־מִבֵּ֥ית הָסוּרִ֖ים יָצָ֣א לִמְלֹ֑ךְ כִּ֛י גַּ֥ם בְּמַלְכוּת֖וֹ נוֹלַ֥ד רָֽשׁ׃

controles.web: For out of prison he came out to be king; yes, even in his kingdom he was born poor.
controles.kjv: For out of prison he cometh to reign; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor.
controles.livre: Porque da prisão ele sai para reinar, ainda que tenha nascido pobre em seu próprio reino.

versos.hebraico: רָאִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת־כָּל־הַ֣חַיִּ֔ים הַֽמְהַלְּכִ֖ים תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ עִ֚ם הַיֶּ֣לֶד הַשֵּׁנִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲמֹ֖ד תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

controles.web: I saw all the living who walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the other, who succeeded him.
controles.kjv: I considered all the living which walk under the sun, with the second child that shall stand up in his stead.
controles.livre: Vi todos os vivos que andam abaixo do sol com o garoto sucessor, que estará em seu lugar.

versos.hebraico: אֵֽין־קֵ֣ץ לְכָל־הָעָ֗ם לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־הָיָה֙ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם גַּ֥ם הָאַחֲרוֹנִ֖ים לֹ֣א יִשְׂמְחוּ־ב֑וֹ כִּֽי־גַם־זֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל וְרַעְי֥וֹן רֽוּחַ׃

controles.web: There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was—yet those who come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a chasing after wind.
controles.kjv: There is no end of all the people, even of all that have been before them: they also that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit.
controles.livre: Não tem fim todo o povo, todo o que houve antes deles; assim como também os descendentes não se alegrarão por ele, de modo que isto também é fútil como perseguir o vento.

versos.hebraico: שְׁמֹ֣ר רגליך כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר תֵּלֵךְ֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְקָר֣וֹב לִשְׁמֹ֔עַ מִתֵּ֥ת הַכְּסִילִ֖ים זָ֑בַח כִּֽי־אֵינָ֥ם יוֹדְעִ֖ים לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת רָֽע׃

controles.web: Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools, for they don’t know that they do evil.
controles.kjv: Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God, and be more ready to hear, than to give the sacrifice of fools: for they consider not that they do evil.
controles.livre: Guarda teu pé, quando entrares na casa de Deus, e prefira te achegares para ouvir do que para dar sacrifícios de tolos, pois não sabem que fazem mal.
